name: technical-image-generation
title_zh: 水彩墨线画技术图，图里的字能看清
tagline_zh: AI 画的架构图十张有九张败在文字上：糊成墨团、拼错、框里塞不下。这套先排版再落笔，标签、箭头、层级都留好位置。
tagline_en: Most AI diagrams die on the text: smeared, misspelled, overflowing. This one lays out labels, arrows and.
desc_en: 生成带清晰文字、结构关系和水彩墨线风格的技术插图与信息图。 Generate readable technical illustrations and infographics with clear text, structural relationships, and a watercolor-and-ink visual language.
why_zh: 把文字和结构当骨架先定死，风格只做表皮。所以它敢画带标注的流程图，而不是一堆好看但读不出的色块。
why_en: Text and structure are locked in as the skeleton; style is only skin. That's why it can render labeled flowcharts instead of.
limit_zh: 只擅长水彩墨线这一种画风，想要扁平矢量、3D 或写实渲染它给不了；长段中文标签仍可能出错字，交付前得自己核一遍。
limit_en: Only the watercolor-and-ink style — no flat vector, 3D or photorealism. Long Chinese labels may still contain typos, so proofread before shipping.
title_en: Watercolor-ink technical diagrams with legible labels
